legs.label: NFL: Bears to win at Falcons
legs.why: Anchor: CHI -118/ATL -102 (VI Oct 18) no-vig 51.7% CHI. Caleb Williams (hamstring) returns after missing 3 games (ESPN inactives: 'Williams to play'); line flipped ATL -1.5 -> CHI -1.5 on that news, total 47.5 -> 51.5, so it is priced. Penix (ribs) expected to start; ATL was 0-2 without him, #8 success rate since his return. CHI offense 14th EPA/play; CHI defense allows 4th-most yds/play and is 24th in EPA/rush vs Bijan Robinson (580 yds, 5.7 ypc): slight ATL lean, offset by CHI 2-1 without Williams. CHI Q list: Monangai, Edwards, Gordon, Stevenson. Weather: dome. Rest: normal. H2H n/a. Kept ~anchor at 51.5%. Polymarket US best Bears ask 51.2c (DefiRate): +0.3c, no edge.

Polymarket TB ask 44c (DefiRate 8:12 AM ET): +1c, below bar.
